03 · Engineering

Details that work

Three systems, each visible in action. Scroll to watch them move — tap any card to replay it.

Active aero spoiler

A carbon wing that rises above 120 km/h and tilts into an air brake under hard deceleration. 380 kg of downforce at V-max.

GT-R · Standard

Panoramic glass roof

A single laminated panel over both rows, with an electrochromic shade that goes from clear to opaque in under two seconds.

S · E · Standard

Ambient lighting

Sixty-four colours across the dash, doors and footwells. The cabin shifts with the drive mode — calm in Comfort, alert in Track.

All models · Standard
